comments.text: install.sh seeds .claude/hooks/principal-identity from the install's git user.name/email (denson / densonsmith2@gmail.com). But pretooluse-author-field-audit.sh audits author-like fields in staged files (plugin.json, *.md frontmatter, LICENSE, etc.) against that allow-list — and the substrate's OWN files carry 'author: Denson Smith' (confirmed 13x across 10 files: CAPTAIN_TIRO.md, templates/*, skills/handoff-author, arc directives). 'Denson Smith' is NOT on the seeded list, so once hooks are enabled the gate false-blocks any commit staging those files. FOUND enabling hooks fleet-wide 2026-06-06; worked around by appending 'Denson Smith' to all 7 deployed allow-lists. FIX: install.sh should seed the artifact-author NAME form into principal-identity in addition to git name+email. Until fixed, any --enable-hooks deploy (user-tier per REDEPLOY_RUNBOOK A.1; the forks) must add 'Denson Smith' to its allow-list manually.

FIXED via install.sh --principal-name. install.sh now accepts --principal-name "<Full Name>" and seeds it into .claude/hooks/principal-identity alongside git user.name/email. Smoke-tested both ways (with flag -> display name added; without -> backward-compat unchanged; bash -n clean), committed on the-stoa main. CUTOVER USAGE: pass it to each hook-bound deploy, e.g. install.sh --target user --principal-name "Denson Smith"; forks with their own principal name. CAVEAT 1: install.sh does NOT clobber an existing principal-identity file, so for an already-seeded workspace either delete that file first or add the name by hand. CAVEAT 2 (residual, separate decision): the DEPLOYED substrate files themselves carry author: Denson Smith (the upstream substrate author). On a non-Denson principal's machine (e.g. Marianne) those files would still flag unless her allow-list also accepts the substrate author OR the gate is changed to skip deployed-substrate paths. Resolve before enabling hooks on a non-Denson workspace.

[from: CAPTAIN_NOMOS] CONFORMANT: independent ground-truth audit of the --principal-name fix (commit 0f1890e). Probe1 (commit) PASS: Author=denson <densonsmith2@gmail.com> (PRINCIPAL), touches substrate/install.sh only (1 file, +13/-1), carries Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 trailer. Probe3 (bash -n) PASS: no syntax error. Probe4 (smoke) PASS: A=with-flag exit0, exact line 'Testy Mcname' present (line 13) + git seeds; B=no-flag exit0, 'Testy Mcname' absent (backward-compat held); bonus: --principal-name with no value exits 2 'requires a name'. Throwaway dirs removed. All four claims hold. Returning.
